title: 2420. Find All Good Indices

examples.explanation: There are two good indices in the array: - Index 2. The subarray [2,1] is in non-increasing order, and the subarray [1,3] is in non-decreasing order. - Index 3. The subarray [1,1] is in non-increasing order, and the subarray [3,4] is in non-decreasing order. Note that the index 4 is not good because [4,1] is not non-decreasing.
There are no good indices in this array.
